checks.text: Typing "listen" in the field labelled "Word or phrase" and clicking the button "Find anagrams" shows a results list containing the items "silent", "enlist", "inlets", "tinsel", and "listen".

With the checkbox labelled "Include original" checked, typing "listen" and clicking "Find anagrams" shows the results list containing "listen" as the first item, followed by "silent", "enlist", "inlets", and "tinsel".
With the checkbox labelled "Include original" unchecked, typing "listen" and clicking "Find anagrams" shows a results list that does not contain "listen".
After finding anagrams for "listen", clicking the button "Copy results" shows a toast with the text "Copied 5 anagrams to clipboard".
After finding anagrams for "listen", clicking the button "Add to favorites" next to the result "silent" adds a row to the table on the tab labelled "Favorites" containing "silent".
On the tab labelled "Favorites", with the row for "silent" present, clicking the button "Remove" in that row removes the row and the table shows the text "No favorites yet".
Typing "aab" in the field labelled "Word or phrase" and clicking "Find anagrams" shows a results list containing only "aba".
Reload keeps the favorites list: after adding "silent" to favorites and reloading the page, the tab labelled "Favorites" still shows a row containing "silent".
